meaning:
1) to murmur, whisper
1a) (Qal) murmurer (participle)
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to murmur
1b2) backbiter (participle)
Also means: nir.gan (נִרְגָּן "whisperer" H5372)

elsewhere.note: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to…
but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.
A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
